svg.title: OpenSpec Feature Workflow Design Book
svg.desc: A spacious two-page SVG design book showing the operator-facing OpenSpec workflow and the architecture overview with all locked design decisions.
svg.text: From initiative idea to archived behavior

The operator creates initiative context, plans one focused story change, converges plan quality, converges implementation quality, absorbs external feedback, publishes a PR, and archives accepted behavior.
0. Create or choose the initiative context
The initiative gives a related set of changes a shared goal, scope, sequencing, and decision history.
"This initiative hardens checkout reliability across payment retries,
duplicate events, and customer-facing failure states."
Operator sees: "I can now plan stories inside this initiative."
The story plan turns one outcome inside the initiative into a concrete OpenSpec change workspace.
"For the first story, retry failed payment webhooks with
A focused change workspace for one user-visible behavior.
2. Review the planning artifacts before code exists
The plan records why the change exists, what behavior changes, how it will be proven, and the red-first task order.
No implementation starts until required artifacts and proof seams are ready.
The operator can approve, edit, or ask for convergence.
A fresh review reads persisted OpenSpec artifacts. Findings are repaired, then review restarts from the files.
Plan reviews write to story.md → ## Plan Review Log.
Converge runs claim/resume until IN REVIEW. The operator opens fresh oblivious review separately.
Review writes reviews.md and DONE only from its fresh session. blocked.md halts converge.
PR review comments, CURe findings, and manual reviewer notes are classified and routed to the right artifact.
Six dispositions route to reviews.md, story.md, or initiative.md.
After local approval, the operator publishes a focused PR, then archives the change when behavior is accepted.
Blocked means the operator must clarify intent, make a product/technical decision, or accept a documented exception.
Commands, schemas, artifacts, gates, and fresh-session loops all converge on repo-local OpenSpec files.
Commands are operator-explicit. When arguments are missing, the operator chooses from eligible initiatives or OpenSpec changes.
A durable initiative groups related story-sized changes and holds initiative-level metadata, decisions, and feedback routing.
## Goal / Context — narrative injected into child sessions
## Story Candidates — ordered list, planning aid, not a tracker
## External Resources — links to design docs, RFCs, Jira tickets
Today: fills gap Jira doesn't cover.
Later: thins to pointer when tickets mature.
One focused behavior change owns its artifacts. Files are the recovery point for fresh sessions and converge loops.
progress.md: claim + timeline + handoff + PR state
blocked.md: gate file — converge halts if present
Plan reviews → story.md ## Plan Review Log
Each converge loop reads its own verdict source:
• Plan converge → story.md ## Plan Review Log
Each resume session finds its repair targets in the right file.
5. plan reviews in story.md; impl. in reviews.md
8. feedback maps 6 dispositions to OS artifacts
A fresh plan-review session reads story.md → ## Plan Review Log. Findings are repaired by plan-resume, then review restarts fresh.
Review verdicts write to story.md ## Plan Review Log.
Resume reads findings from there and repairs the plan artifacts.
Review finds acceptance covers retries but proof matrix misses duplicate delivery → resume adds idempotency scenario → review reruns → approved.
Claim/resume advances checkbox tasks and records evidence until IN REVIEW. Review starts later from a fresh oblivious session.
Implementation evidence in progress.md; reviews.md is read only when fixing prior findings; blocked.md halts the loop.
Claim implements retries and adds test → resume completes proof → story reaches IN REVIEW → operator opens fresh oblivious review.
Explicit file in the change folder. Converge loop refuses to continue while it exists.
Contains: reason, decision needed from operator, affected artifacts. Operator removes or annotates to unblock.
/openspec-archive delegates to /opsx:archive for spec sync + archive move.
Pre-flight: PR merged? review approved? tasks done? Post-archive: update initiative.md.

Legend: green = operator command · blue = OpenSpec artifact · cyan = custom workflow artifact · orange = readiness/review gate · yellow = locked design decision · purple = durable spec/archive · red = block gate.
See notebook page openspec-add-flow-assessment for the full locked-decisions record and source provenance.
